authority_scale.claim: authority parameters converge to a clinical hierarchy
authority_scale.why: The reported values are the initialisation plus less than one percent. A parameter that agrees with its own starting point to two decimals across independent seeds was not discovered by training.

guideline_bank.claim: retrieval over a bank of clinical guidelines
guideline_bank.why: The bank is a randomly initialised parameter matrix. There is no corpus, no guideline text and no retrieval: attention is computed against learned noise, so nothing about clinical guidelines enters the model through it.

harm_head.claim: a harm head predicting clinical severity
harm_head.why: The head runs in the forward pass and its output is returned, but the objective is a weighted sum of the contradiction and rule-type losses only. No gradient reaches it, so its scores are those of an untrained sigmoid at every step of training.

provenance.limitation: Verifies the source as recovered. It does not establish that these notebooks are the code that produced the reported checkpoint, which no surviving artifact records.
provenance.requires: no MIMIC data, no network, no GPU, no checkpoint
